pages.text: Hold wood and right-click the $(item)Wood Lathe$(). Hold to press the chisel in, faster the deeper it goes; let go in the green. Three passes. A billet becomes a $(item)Staff Shaft$(), a stave two $(item)Hafts$(), a haft a $(item)Wand Core$().
pages.title: Turning

pages.text: A finish caps wooden gear's ★: $(item)Linseed Oil$() (four wheat seeds in a cooking pot) for ★3, dryad resins for more. Bows take bent limbs, bowstrings and a finish; crossbows add a stock and iron.
pages.title: Finishes
